Definition: from a derivative of G3501; a youth (up to about forty years):--young man.
BiblicalUsage: At Stephen's stoning the witnesses lay their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul, and a young man named Eutychus falls from the third loft as Paul preaches long into the night.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two young men frame the church's beginning: one watches a murder and one sleeps through a sermon, and God uses them both — Saul to become Paul, and Eutychus to be raised from the dead.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
